summary: The purpose of this staff report is to report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a Clothing Drop Box Location permit at 1 Rannock Street.
decided: City Council on February 2 and 3, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the application for the proposed Clothing Drop Box Location permit at 1 Rannock Street.
